name: agent-record-adapter
description: Install Agent Record Adapter into your AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and Claude Desktop): the official vercel-labs agent-desktop and agent-browser, unmodified, plus a background-only mode (never your mouse, keyboard or focus), record, saved passwords and Desktop Recorder (record a task and play it again, without AI). Windows now; macOS and Linux coming soon.
